import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16
ROWS, HIDDEN = 32768, 4096  # batch*seq x hidden, ~256 MiB in / ~256 MiB out (fp16)


class Model(nn.Module):
    # RMSNorm (fp32 stats) -> per-channel affine -> SiLU-style self-gating -> fp16
    def __init__(self, dt=DT, hidden=HIDDEN, eps=1e-5):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
        self.eps = eps
        self.weight = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(hidden, generator=g)).to(device=dev, dtype=dt))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter((0.05 * torch.randn(hidden, generator=g)).to(device=dev, dtype=dt))
        self.gate = nn.Parameter((0.5 + 0.1 * torch.randn(hidden, generator=g)).to(device=dev, dtype=dt))

    def forward(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        ms = xf.square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        y = xf * torch.rsqrt(ms + self.eps)
        y = y * self.weight.float() + self.bias.float()
        out = y * torch.sigmoid(y * self.gate.float())
        return out.to(x.dtype)


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
    x = torch.randn(ROWS, HIDDEN, generator=g).to(device=dev, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

DT = torch.float16
ROWS, HIDDEN = 16384, 8192
_DEV = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm residual block minus the matmul:
        y = x + gelu_tanh(LayerNorm(x) * w + b)
    Row-wise mean/var reduction + elementwise chain over a 16384 x 8192 fp16 tensor
    (256 MiB in, 256 MiB out). fp32 math internally, fp16 out.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.eps = 1e-5
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        b = 0.05 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(w.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(b.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        mean = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        xc = xf - mean
        var = xc.square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = xc * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        h = h * self.weight.float() + self.bias.float()
        h = F.gelu(h, approximate="tanh")
        return (xf + h).to(x.dtype)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16

ROWS = 32768   # tokens (e.g. batch 16 x seq 2048)
COLS = 4096    # hidden size


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Fused row-wise chain on a [tokens, hidden] fp16 activation matrix:
    #   LayerNorm(affine) -> gated activation h*sigmoid(a*h+b) -> temperature softmax over hidden.
    # Four row reductions (mean, var, max, sum) + elementwise chain; fp32 math, fp16 out.
    # Ideal traffic: read x once (256 MiB) + write out once (256 MiB) -> bandwidth-bound.
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
        self.eps = 1e-5
        self.temperature = 0.7
        self.ln_weight = nn.Parameter(
            (1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(COLS, generator=g)).to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.ln_bias = nn.Parameter(
            (0.1 * torch.randn(COLS, generator=g)).to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate_scale = nn.Parameter(
            (0.5 + 0.5 * torch.rand(COLS, generator=g)).to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate_shift = nn.Parameter(
            (0.2 * torch.randn(COLS, generator=g)).to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        # x: [ROWS, COLS] fp16
        xf = x.float()
        mean = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        xc = xf - mean
        var = xc.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = xc * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        h = h * self.ln_weight.float() + self.ln_bias.float()
        z = h * torch.sigmoid(h * self.gate_scale.float() + self.gate_shift.float())
        z = z / self.temperature
        z = z - z.amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        e = torch.exp(z)
        out = e / e.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        return out.to(x.dtype)


def get_inputs():
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
    row_scale = 0.5 + 3.0 * torch.rand(ROWS, 1, generator=g)
    row_shift = torch.randn(ROWS, 1, generator=g)
    x = torch.randn(ROWS, COLS, generator=g) * row_scale + row_shift
    return [x.to(device=device, dtype=DT)]

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # LayerNorm(fp32 stats) -> GELU(tanh) * sigmoid-gate -> residual -> row-wise log-softmax
    # on a [16384, 4096] fp16 tensor. Pure elementwise chain + 4 row reductions;
    # ideal traffic is one read + one write of x (bandwidth-bound).
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.eps = 1e-5
        N = 4096
        dev = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        self.ln_w = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(N, generator=g)).to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.ln_b = nn.Parameter((0.05 * torch.randn(N, generator=g)).to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate_w = nn.Parameter((0.5 * torch.randn(N, generator=g)).to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate_b = nn.Parameter((0.1 * torch.randn(N, generator=g)).to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        mu = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        xc = xf - mu
        var = (xc * xc).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = xc * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        h = h * self.ln_w.float() + self.ln_b.float()
        act = F.gelu(h, approximate="tanh")
        gate = torch.sigmoid(h * self.gate_w.float() + self.gate_b.float())
        y = act * gate + xf
        m = y.amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        z = y - m
        lse = torch.log(torch.exp(z).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True))
        return (z - lse).to(x.dtype)


def get_inputs():
    dev = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    g = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(16384, 4096, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32, generator=g).to(DT)
    return [x]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16

ROWS = 32768
DIM = 4096


class Model(nn.Module):
    """RMSNorm -> affine -> GELU(tanh) -> layer-scaled residual -> RMSNorm -> scale.

    Memory-bound fused chain over a [ROWS, DIM] fp16 tensor: two dependent
    row-wise reductions (sum of squares of x, then of the residual stream)
    plus a long elementwise tail. Math in fp32, output in fp16.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.eps = 1e-6
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
        w_in = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g)
        b_in = 0.05 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g)
        w_res = 0.5 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g)
        w_out = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g)
        self.w_in = nn.Parameter(w_in.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.b_in = nn.Parameter(b_in.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_res = nn.Parameter(w_res.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_out = nn.Parameter(w_out.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        # pre-norm (RMSNorm) + affine
        inv1 = torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        h = xf * inv1 * self.w_in.float() + self.b_in.float()
        # GELU, tanh approximation
        a = 0.5 * h * (1.0 + torch.tanh(0.7978845608028654 * (h + 0.044715 * h * h * h)))
        # layer-scaled residual add back onto the stream
        y = xf + a * self.w_res.float()
        # post-norm (RMSNorm) + scale
        inv2 = torch.rsqrt(y.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        out = y * inv2 * self.w_out.float()
        return out.to(x.dtype)


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(ROWS, DIM, device=dev, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

    # Row-wise fused chain on a 2-D tensor:
    #   LayerNorm(affine) -> quick-GELU -> RMS re-normalization -> per-channel output scale
    # Three row reductions (mean, var, mean-of-squares) interleaved with elementwise math.
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        w = 1.0 + 0.10 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        b = 0.05 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        s = 1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        self.ln_weight = nn.Parameter(w.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.ln_bias = nn.Parameter(b.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.out_scale = nn.Parameter(s.to(device=_DEV, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.eps = 1e-5

        xf = x.float()
        mean = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)

DT = torch.float16

# Transformer-scale GEMM: (batch*seq) x hidden  @  hidden x hidden
M, K, N = 8192, 4096, 4096


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    y = gelu_tanh(x @ W^T + b) * s + x

    A single fp16 GEMM followed by a fused epilogue:
    per-channel bias -> tanh-GELU -> per-channel scale -> residual add of x.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        w = torch.randn(N, K, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * (1.0 / K ** 0.5)
        b = torch.randn(N, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * 0.1
        s = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(N, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(w.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(b.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.scale = nn.Parameter(s.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)          # [M, N] fp16 GEMM + bias
        h = F.gelu(h, approximate="tanh")                # activation
        return h * self.scale + x                        # per-channel scale + residual

    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(M, K, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32).to(device=device, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

# Transformer-scale GEMM: (batch*seq) x hidden -> hidden
M = 8192   # tokens (e.g. batch 8 x seq 1024)
K = 4096   # input features
N = 4096   # output features (== K so the residual is well-defined)

class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    out = x + gamma * gelu(x @ W^T + b)

    One fp16 GEMM (cuBLAS-friendly [N,K] weight layout) followed by a fused
    epilogue: bias -> tanh-GELU -> per-channel LayerScale -> residual add.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
        w = torch.randn(N, K, generator=g) * (1.0 / K ** 0.5)
        b = torch.randn(N, generator=g) * 0.02
        gamma = 0.5 + 0.5 * torch.rand(N, generator=g)
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(w.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(b.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(gamma.to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)      # [M, N] GEMM + bias
        y = F.gelu(y, approximate="tanh")            # activation
        y = y * self.gamma                           # per-channel scale
        return x + y                                 # residual


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1)
    x = torch.randn(M, K, generator=g).to(device=_DEVICE, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    LayerScale-style residual projection block (transformer-realistic):
        out = x + gamma * gelu_tanh(x @ W^T + b)
    One 8192x4096x4096 fp16 GEMM with a fused epilogue
    (bias + tanh-GELU + per-channel scale + residual add).
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        K, N = 4096, 4096
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
        w = torch.randn(N, K, generator=g) * (K ** -0.5)
        b = torch.randn(N, generator=g) * 0.02
        gamma = 0.5 + 0.5 * torch.rand(N, generator=g)
        self.register_buffer("weight", w.to(device=device, dtype=dt))
        self.register_buffer("bias", b.to(device=device, dtype=dt))

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16
DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

BATCH = 4
SEQ = 2048
HIDDEN = 1024
HEADS = 16
HEAD_DIM = HIDDEN // HEADS  # 64
LN_EPS = 1e-5


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Pre-LN causal multi-head self-attention sub-layer with rotary embeddings,
    written out explicitly (materialized (B,nh,S,S) scores, fp32 masked softmax),
    followed by output projection, residual add and a second LayerNorm."""

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.n_heads = HEADS
        self.head_dim = HEAD_DIM
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(HEAD_DIM)

        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)

        def rand(*shape, std):
            return torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32) * std

        # LayerNorm 1
        self.ln1_w = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * rand(HIDDEN, std=1.0)).to(DEVICE, dt))
        self.ln1_b = nn.Parameter((0.1 * rand(HIDDEN, std=1.0)).to(DEVICE, dt))
        # Fused QKV projection, nn.Linear (out, in) layout
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(rand(3 * HIDDEN, HIDDEN, std=0.02).to(DEVICE, dt))
        self.b_qkv = nn.Parameter((0.01 * rand(3 * HIDDEN, std=1.0)).to(DEVICE, dt))
        # Output projection
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter(rand(HIDDEN, HIDDEN, std=0.02).to(DEVICE, dt))
        self.b_o = nn.Parameter((0.01 * rand(HIDDEN, std=1.0)).to(DEVICE, dt))
        # LayerNorm 2
        self.ln2_w = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * rand(HIDDEN, std=1.0)).to(DEVICE, dt))
        self.ln2_b = nn.Parameter((0.1 * rand(HIDDEN, std=1.0)).to(DEVICE, dt))

        # Rotary embedding tables
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HEAD_DIM))
        t = torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32)
        freqs = torch.outer(t, inv_freq)            # (S, d/2)
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)      # (S, d)
        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", emb.cos().to(DEVICE, dt), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", emb.sin().to(DEVICE, dt), persistent=False)

        # Causal mask (True = masked out)
        mask = torch.triu(torch.ones(SEQ, SEQ, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1)
        self.register_buffer("causal_mask", mask.to(DEVICE), persistent=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(x):
        x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([-x2, x1], dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, H = x.shape
        nh, d = self.n_heads, self.head_dim

        # --- LayerNorm 1 (fp32 statistics, fp16 affine) ---
        xf = x.float()
        mu = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        var = xf.var(dim=-1, unbiased=False, keepdim=True)
        h = ((xf - mu) * torch.rsqrt(var + LN_EPS)).to(self.dt) * self.ln1_w + self.ln1_b

        # --- QKV projection ---
        qkv = h @ self.w_qkv.t() + self.b_qkv                 # (B, S, 3H)
        q, k, v = qkv.split(H, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(B, S, nh, d).transpose(1, 2)               # (B, nh, S, d)
        k = k.view(B, S, nh, d).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(B, S, nh, d).transpose(1, 2)

        # --- Rotary position embeddings on q, k ---
        cos = self.rope_cos[:S].view(1, 1, S, d)
        sin = self.rope_sin[:S].view(1, 1, S, d)
        q = q * cos + self._rotate_half(q) * sin
        k = k * cos + self._rotate_half(k) * sin

        # --- Causal scaled dot-product attention, fully materialized ---
        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) * self.scale   # (B, nh, S, S) fp16
        scores = scores.float().masked_fill(self.causal_mask[:S, :S], float("-inf"))
        probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).to(self.dt)
        ctx = torch.matmul(probs, v)                                 # (B, nh, S, d)
        ctx = ctx.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, H)

        # --- Output projection + residual ---
        y = x + (ctx @ self.w_o.t() + self.b_o)

        # --- LayerNorm 2 (fp32 statistics, fp16 affine) ---
        yf = y.float()
        mu2 = yf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        var2 = yf.var(dim=-1, unbiased=False, keepdim=True)
        out = ((yf - mu2) * torch.rsqrt(var2 + LN_EPS)).to(self.dt) * self.ln2_w + self.ln2_b
        return out


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, HIDDEN, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
    return [x.to(DEVICE, DT)]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # LLaMA-style causal self-attention sublayer on a realistic decoder shape:
    #   RMSNorm -> fused QKV GEMM -> RoPE (fp32) -> grouped-query causal attention
    #   (fp16 QK^T, fp32 mask+softmax, fp16 PV) -> out-proj -> residual -> RMSNorm
    B, S, D = 4, 2048, 2048
    N_HEADS, N_KV_HEADS = 16, 4
    HEAD_DIM = D // N_HEADS  # 128
    EPS = 1e-5

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        S, D, H, HKV, HD = self.S, self.D, self.N_HEADS, self.N_KV_HEADS, self.HEAD_DIM
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
        self.norm1_w = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g)).to(dev, dt))
        self.norm2_w = nn.Parameter((1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(D, generator=g)).to(dev, dt))
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(
            (torch.randn((H + 2 * HKV) * HD, D, generator=g) * D ** -0.5).to(dev, dt)
        )
        self.w_o = nn.Parameter((torch.randn(D, D, generator=g) * D ** -0.5).to(dev, dt))
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, HD, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HD))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)  # [S, HD]
        self.register_buffer("cos", emb.cos().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", emb.sin().to(dev), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer(
            "mask", torch.triu(torch.ones(S, S, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1).to(dev), persistent=False
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _rotate_half(t):
        t1, t2 = t.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([-t2, t1], dim=-1)

    def _rmsnorm(self, t, w):
        tf = t.float()
        tf = tf * torch.rsqrt(tf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.EPS)
        return (tf * w.float()).to(t.dtype)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s, _ = x.shape
        H, HKV, HD, D = self.N_HEADS, self.N_KV_HEADS, self.HEAD_DIM, self.D

        h = self._rmsnorm(x, self.norm1_w)
        qkv = h @ self.w_qkv.t()                                     # [B, S, (H+2*HKV)*HD]
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [H * HD, HKV * HD, HKV * HD], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(b, s, H, HD).transpose(1, 2)                      # [B, H,   S, HD]
        k = k.view(b, s, HKV, HD).transpose(1, 2)                    # [B, HKV, S, HD]
        v = v.view(b, s, HKV, HD).transpose(1, 2)

        cos = self.cos[:s][None, None]
        sin = self.sin[:s][None, None]
        qf, kf = q.float(), k.float()
        q = (qf * cos + self._rotate_half(qf) * sin).to(x.dtype)
        k = (kf * cos + self._rotate_half(kf) * sin).to(x.dtype)

        rep = H // HKV
        k = k.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)                          # [B, H, S, HD]
        v = v.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)

        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)).float() * (HD ** -0.5)   # [B, H, S, S]
        scores = scores.masked_fill(self.mask[:s, :s], float("-inf"))
        p = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).to(x.dtype)
        o = torch.matmul(p, v)                                       # [B, H, S, HD]
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, s, D)
        o = o @ self.w_o.t()

        return self._rmsnorm(x + o, self.norm2_w)


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
    return [torch.randn(Model.B, Model.S, Model.D, generator=g).to(dev, DT)]

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Pre-LN transformer block (GPT/LLaMA hybrid): LN -> fused QKV -> RoPE -> causal MHA
    # (fp32 softmax) -> out-proj -> residual -> LN -> GELU MLP -> residual -> final LN.
    B, S, D, H = 8, 1024, 1024, 16
    HD = D // H
    FF = 4 * D
    N_LAYERS = 24
    EPS = 1e-5

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        D, H, HD, S, FF = self.D, self.H, self.HD, self.S, self.FF

        def P(t):
            return nn.Parameter(t.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)

        def rnd(*shape, std=1.0, mean=0.0):
            return torch.randn(*shape, generator=g) * std + mean

        proj_std = 0.02 / math.sqrt(2 * self.N_LAYERS)
        self.ln1_w, self.ln1_b = P(rnd(D, std=0.05, mean=1.0)), P(rnd(D, std=0.05))
        self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv = P(rnd(3 * D, D, std=0.02)), P(rnd(3 * D, std=0.01))
        self.w_o, self.b_o = P(rnd(D, D, std=proj_std)), P(rnd(D, std=0.01))
        self.ln2_w, self.ln2_b = P(rnd(D, std=0.05, mean=1.0)), P(rnd(D, std=0.05))
        self.w_fc, self.b_fc = P(rnd(FF, D, std=0.02)), P(rnd(FF, std=0.01))
        self.w_pr, self.b_pr = P(rnd(D, FF, std=proj_std)), P(rnd(D, std=0.01))
        self.ln3_w, self.ln3_b = P(rnd(D, std=0.05, mean=1.0)), P(rnd(D, std=0.05))

        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, HD, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HD))
        ang = torch.outer(torch.arange(S, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)
        ang = torch.cat([ang, ang], dim=-1)  # [S, HD]
        self.register_buffer("cos", ang.cos().to(dev, dt)[None, None])  # [1,1,S,HD]
        self.register_buffer("sin", ang.sin().to(dev, dt)[None, None])
        self.register_buffer("causal", torch.ones(S, S).tril().bool().to(dev)[None, None])

    @staticmethod
    def _rot_half(t):
        a, b = t.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat((-b, a), dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        Bn, Sn, D = x.shape
        H, HD = self.H, self.HD
        # ---- attention sub-block ----
        h = F.layer_norm(x, (D,), self.ln1_w, self.ln1_b, self.EPS)
        q, k, v = F.linear(h, self.w_qkv, self.b_qkv).split(D, dim=-1)
        q = q.view(Bn, Sn, H, HD).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.view(Bn, Sn, H, HD).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(Bn, Sn, H, HD).transpose(1, 2)
        cos, sin = self.cos[:, :, :Sn], self.sin[:, :, :Sn]
        q = q * cos + self._rot_half(q) * sin
        k = k * cos + self._rot_half(k) * sin
        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) * (1.0 / math.sqrt(HD))
        scores = scores.masked_fill(~self.causal[:, :, :Sn, :Sn], float("-inf"))
        p = torch.softmax(scores.float(), dim=-1).to(x.dtype)
        o = torch.matmul(p, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(Bn, Sn, D)
        x = x + F.linear(o, self.w_o, self.b_o)
        # ---- MLP sub-block ----
        h = F.layer_norm(x, (D,), self.ln2_w, self.ln2_b, self.EPS)
        h = F.gelu(F.linear(h, self.w_fc, self.b_fc))
        x = x + F.linear(h, self.w_pr, self.b_pr)
        return F.layer_norm(x, (D,), self.ln3_w, self.ln3_b, self.EPS)


def get_inputs():
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(4321)
    x = torch.randn(Model.B, Model.S, Model.D, generator=g)
    return [x.to(dev, DT)]

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# realistic decoder attention sub-block shapes (GQA: 16 query heads, 4 kv heads, head_dim 64)
BATCH, SEQ, DIM, HEADS, KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM = 8, 1024, 1024, 16, 4, 64


class Model(nn.Module):
    # pre-LN -> fused GQA QKV projection -> per-head QK RMSNorm -> RoPE
    # -> causal attention with fp32 softmax -> out projection -> post-LN -> residual
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.h, self.kvh, self.hd = HEADS, KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(HEAD_DIM)
        self.rms_eps = 1e-6
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(DIM, eps=1e-5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(DIM, (HEADS + 2 * KV_HEADS) * HEAD_DIM, bias=True)
        self.q_norm_w = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(HEAD_DIM))
        self.k_norm_w = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(HEAD_DIM))
        self.proj = nn.Linear(HEADS * HEAD_DIM, DIM, bias=True)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(DIM, eps=1e-5)
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.qkv.weight.copy_(0.02 * torch.randn(self.qkv.weight.shape, generator=g))
            self.qkv.bias.copy_(0.02 * torch.randn(self.qkv.bias.shape, generator=g))
            self.proj.weight.copy_(0.02 * torch.randn(self.proj.weight.shape, generator=g))
            self.proj.bias.copy_(0.02 * torch.randn(self.proj.bias.shape, generator=g))
            self.ln1.weight.copy_(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g))
            self.ln1.bias.copy_(0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g))
            self.ln2.weight.copy_(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g))
            self.ln2.bias.copy_(0.1 * torch.randn(DIM, generator=g))
            self.q_norm_w.copy_(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HEAD_DIM, generator=g))
            self.k_norm_w.copy_(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HEAD_DIM, generator=g))
        self.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=dt)
        # rotary tables kept in fp32, causal mask as bool
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / HEAD_DIM))
        freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(SEQ, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat([freqs, freqs], dim=-1)
        self.register_buffer("cos", emb.cos().to(DEVICE), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", emb.sin().to(DEVICE), persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer(
            "mask", torch.triu(torch.ones(SEQ, SEQ, dtype=torch.bool, device=DEVICE), diagonal=1), persistent=False
        )

    def _rms(self, t, w):
        tf = t.float()
        return tf * torch.rsqrt(tf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.rms_eps) * w.float()

    @staticmethod
    def _rot(t):
        d = t.shape[-1] // 2
        return torch.cat([-t[..., d:], t[..., :d]], dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s, _ = x.shape
        h = self.ln1(x)
        qkv = self.qkv(h)
        q, k, v = torch.split(qkv, [self.h * self.hd, self.kvh * self.hd, self.kvh * self.hd], dim=-1)
        q = q.view(b, s, self.h, self.hd)
        k = k.view(b, s, self.kvh, self.hd)
        v = v.view(b, s, self.kvh, self.hd)
        q = self._rms(q, self.q_norm_w)
        k = self._rms(k, self.k_norm_w)
        cos = self.cos[:s][None, :, None, :]
        sin = self.sin[:s][None, :, None, :]
        q = (q * cos + self._rot(q) * sin).to(x.dtype).transpose(1, 2)   # [B,H,S,HD]
        k = (k * cos + self._rot(k) * sin).to(x.dtype).transpose(1, 2)   # [B,KVH,S,HD]
        v = v.transpose(1, 2)                                            # [B,KVH,S,HD]
        rep = self.h // self.kvh
        k = k.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=1)
        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)).float() * self.scale
        scores = scores.masked_fill(self.mask[:s, :s], float("-inf"))
        attn = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).to(x.dtype)
        o = torch.matmul(attn, v)                                        # [B,H,S,HD]
        o = o.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, s, self.h * self.hd)
        o = self.proj(o)
        return x + self.ln2(o)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ, DIM, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=DT)]
